    Read accounting for an image

    Source: R/hsi-meta.R
    at_read_stats.Rd

    Report how many tiles were requested from an image's backend, how many payload bytes were read from its file by windowed readers, and how many bytes were returned as decoded arrays. Cache hits are not counted as reads.

    Usage

    at_read_stats(img, reset = FALSE, call = rlang::caller_env())

    Arguments

    img

    An annot_image.

    reset

    Logical; reset the counters for this image after reporting.

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    Value

    A list with tiles (integer), file_bytes, decoded_bytes and max_tile_bytes (doubles), plus window_read (logical) and the current max_tile_bytes_limit from option annotatR.max_tile_bytes.

    See also

    Other hsi: at_band_operations(), at_band_view(), at_convert_values(), at_cubert_export_envi(), at_hsi_meta(), at_tivita_profile()

    Examples

    cube <- at_example_image("cube")
invisible(at_tile(cube, xrange = c(1, 4), yrange = c(1, 4), bands = 1:2))
at_read_stats(cube)$tiles
#> [1] 3
